decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications:  EX00, EX01, EX02, EX03, EX04, EX05 (Rev A), EX06, EX07, EX08, EX09, P00, P01, P02, P03, P04, P05, P06 (Rev A), P07, P08, P09
Received: 15 April 2026,  N.200100-01/ N.200100-02, N.200100-03/ N.200100-04, N.200100-05/ N.200100-08, N.200100-06/ N.200100-07, N.200100-09/ N.200100-10, N.200100-11/ N.200100-12, P01, P02, P03, Unreferenced High Performance Flush Window Received: 07 January 2026,  PP-14577472v1 Received: 19 December 2025.  

Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.

Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or openings shall be formed in the side and rear elevations, or roofs, of the development hereby permitted.

Reason: In order to protect neighbours' privacy.
application_type_full: Householder planning & demolition in a conservation area
description: Erection of a rear roof dormer; a single-storey rear infill and single-storey rear extension; re-tiling of the existing roof; installation of one front rooflight; matching designed replacement of front, side and rear double glazed windows and the front door; installation of first floor rear glazed double doors with a Juliet balcony; replacement guttering and drainpipes; removal of one first floor side window with matching wall infill; and installation of a new side gate within the house's side access pathway.
